Developer, network technician and teacher.

I help organisations turn ideas into systems people can use, support, and trust.

I’m a full-stack developer and IT tutor based in Arusha, Tanzania. My work combines software development with practical IT support, so I understand both the technical side of a system and the day-to-day reality of the people using it.

I studied Information Technology at Arusha Technical College and worked in IT support in hospitals and health centres across Arusha. In those roles, I helped maintain networks, troubleshoot computers, and support health information systems such as GoT-HOMIS and DHIS2.

Today I teach programming, web development and network security at Arusha Computing Centre, while also building websites, web systems, mobile apps and support plans for organisations that need dependable digital tools.
